entries.description: An educational and fundraising multi-media caravan planning a tour of the West Coast and Southwest with slides, movies, literature, puppet shows, music, trade and barter, and speeches, seeking to schedule stops.
entries.raw_text: OREGON WOMEN'S LAND: plans an educational and fundraising multi-media caravan in early fall. Slides, movies, literature, puppet shows, music, trade & barter, speeches, conversation and connection. West Coast & Southwest & ? Write to schedule a stop in your area. OWL, PO Box 1713, Eugene, OR, 97401.
entries.notes: Type is Land Fund/Seeking Land because it is a fundraising group for Oregon Women's Land. Accepted groups: 'women' before 1986 means Lesbian women and Non-lesbian women. Focuses: Archives/cultural work ('Slides, movies, literature, puppet shows, music') and Workshops/education ('educational... speeches').
